name: semantic-search
description: Local semantic documentation search with a shared watcher daemon, batched indexing and project-local SQLite indexes.

interface.longDescription: Initialize documentation folders in each project. Session hooks register watchers with one shared daemon. A recoverable queue batches multilingual embeddings across projects; SQLite indexes stay in each project, while the model and queue journal live in system tmp.
defaultPrompt: Use $semantic-search:search to find relevant project documentation.
